about: Server per-item passive cooldown list: the names (FixedString) of passives of an item that are on a per-item cooldown. Saved (savegame model game.cooldown.v0.PerItemPassiveCooldownComponent, 16 bytes; no member names known), handled by esv::PerItemPassiveCooldownRestoreSystem together with the Restored/Removed events and esv::PerItemPassiveRestoredCooldownComponent. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

evidence.says: Storage set-up bg3.exe+0x2705760: size 0x10, destructor bg3.exe+0x6CC770 -> FUN_1405C4050(p, 0), which DecRefs `*(uint32*)(*p + i * 4)` for i < size(+0xC) and frees `*p` - an Array of FixedStrings. Savegame loader slot bg3.exe+0x2601C00 (table bg3.exe+0x5716548, loader object built by bg3.exe+0x24EA1A0) reads the strings with ls__FixedString__GetString(*p + i*4) and writes `*(int*)(*p + i*4)`. Name inferred from the component name (passive ids).
